title: August 2026 – OncLive
summary: Atebimetinib (IMM-1-104), an investigational oral MEK1/2 inhibitor, may improve the efficacy of standard chemotherapy in the first-line treatment of metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), according to Daniel H. Ahn, DO.
